name: first-view
meaning: The page or a section comes into view, and its content enters and settles.

name: idle-stretch
meaning: The visitor does nothing, and a steady loop keeps the page alive.

name: hover-across-options
meaning: The pointer moves across a set of choices, and the page marks the one under it.

name: scroll-through-chapters
meaning: Scrolling moves the page through set stages in order, and scrolling back reverses them.

name: scroll-speed
meaning: The page shows how fast the visitor scrolls, then settles when the scroll stops.

name: travel-into-a-scene
meaning: The view moves deep into one scene, or pulls back to show all of it.

name: browse-a-row
meaning: The visitor moves a row of items sideways to look through them.

name: drag-and-release
meaning: The visitor drags a part of the page, it follows the hand, and on release it springs back, coasts or settles.

name: tilt-the-device
meaning: Device tilt moves a part of the page, and it settles when the device holds still.

name: pick-an-item
meaning: The visitor picks one item, and the item flies to its place or the view flies to it.

name: switch-a-mode
meaning: The visitor changes a mode or a choice, and the scene moves from the old state to the new one.

name: step-to-the-next
meaning: The visitor moves on one step, and the old content leaves as the new content arrives.

name: remove-an-item
meaning: An item leaves the page for good, and the space it held clears.

name: open-and-close
meaning: One tap opens a set of pieces, and a second tap closes them the same way back.

name: reveal-a-result
meaning: One action starts a timed sequence of steps, and the result arrives last.

name: count-up
meaning: A number climbs to its value, and the visuals linked to it move with it.

name: celebrate
meaning: A success or a finished action gets a short burst of motion.
